sentences.text: La familia de Marta es grande.
Marta tiene un padre y una madre.
sentences.english: Marta has a father and a mother.

sentences.text: Pedro, Rosa, Luis y Marta viven en una casa.
sentences.english: Pedro, Rosa, Luis and Marta live in a house.

sentences.text: En la casa hay una mesa grande.
sentences.english: In the house there is a big table.

sentences.text: La familia come en la mesa.
sentences.english: The family eats at the table.

sentences.text: Marta quiere mucho a su familia.
sentences.english: Marta loves her family very much.
